select_groupby_positional_slice: select rows from each groupby group using a positional slice like _positional_selector[1:3]
select_groupby_positional_list: select rows from each groupby group using a positional list like _positional_selector[0, -1]
select_groupby_positional_mixed: select rows from each groupby group using mixed integers and slices in _positional_selector
select_groupby_nth_callable: select the nth row from each groupby group using the nth callable syntax
select_groupby_nth_index: select the nth row from each groupby group using the nth index syntax
